............

Wandering around all day
instead of working!
Just who are you, anyway?

{cmd:7F04}
{cmd:7F02}Whoops! I'd better stop
poking my nose in.
Everyone's got things
they don't want brought up...
{cmd:7F04}

sleeves is a fated meeting.

was meant to be, too.

en.source: Original translation of the Japanese N64 entry
en.text:
The night's only just begun,
but it's getting dark.
Little kids should head home!
...
{cmd:7F04}
{cmd:7F02}Whoops! There I go,
meddling again. Whew...
That was rude to someone
I've only just met.
{cmd:7F04}
{cmd:7F02}Heh heh! Let it slide
for today, will you?
We might be in for
a long friendship!
{cmd:7F01}

en.source: Original translation of the Japanese N64 entry
en.text:
Hey! It's long past
the time for respectable
folks to be out wandering!
Get yourself home!
{cmd:7F04}
{cmd:7F02}...There I go again.
It's rude to say
something like that
to a stranger, isn't it?
{cmd:7F04}
{cmd:7F02}What's your name?
...
Oh, {cmd:7F1A}, is it?
Well, now you've told me,
{cmd:7F04}
{cmd:7F02}we're not strangers anymore!
So let me say this!
Get yourself home,
climb into bed, and sleep!
{cmd:7F01}

{cmd:7F01}

...

You're strange. Oh, all right.
{cmd:7F04}
{cmd:7F02}My name's {cmd:7F1B}.
Come over anytime
you feel lonely!
Don't be shy!
{cmd:7F01}
